name: Flodesk
description:
Flodesk is email marketing and audience management built for creators and small businesses. This connector lets you ask about your Flodesk account in plain language instead of clicking through reports, and act on your subscriber list without leaving the conversation.

On the reading side: overall open, click and unsubscribe rates across every campaign you've sent; a ranked view of individual emails by whichever metric you care about; engagement trends bucketed by day, week or month; and the send times your particular audience responds to. The same goes for your audience — list size and growth over time, how your segments compare, what rule a segment is built on, who received or opened a specific email, and the full profile of any individual subscriber. Signup form performance, automation workflow results and checkout revenue are covered too.

On the writing side, the connector can create a subscriber, add or remove someone from a static segment, update a subscriber's profile fields, unsubscribe a person who asked off the list, and save a filtered audience as a segment that keeps itself up to date. Each of those is a separate tool with its own annotations — nothing is bundled behind a generic "action" parameter — and the three that change or remove existing data are marked destructive, so Claude confirms before running them. Creating a subscriber is a find-or-create that never overwrites an existing record, and membership writes are idempotent.

Connect with the Flodesk account you already have, over OAuth. The connector reads and writes only your own Flodesk data, and calls only Flodesk's own APIs. No tool sends or schedules email.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Flodesk to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Flodesk to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.flodesk.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Flodesk MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flodesk lists 24 MCP tools, including add_subscriber_to_segment, create_segment, create_subscriber, flodesk_overview, get_checkout_totals, get_email_totals, get_email_trends, get_me, get_send_time_insights, get_subscriber, get_subscriber_totals, and get_subscriber_trends.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Flodesk?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Flodesk in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Flodesk requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Flodesk is developed by Flodesk Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
